ex.en: Iceland gets much of its power from geothermal energy.
ex.zh: 冰島大部分的電力來自地熱能。

ex.en: The area has many geothermal hot springs.
ex.zh: 這一帶有很多地熱溫泉。

ex.en: Tom is a very generous man.
ex.zh: 湯姆是個非常大方的人。

ex.en: He is generous to his opponents.
ex.zh: 他對對手很寬厚。

ex.en: Mother Nature is generous.
ex.zh: 大自然很慷慨。

ex.en: The restaurant serves generous portions.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳份量很大。

ex.en: She received a generous salary increase.
ex.zh: 她獲得了可觀的加薪。

ex.en: The email was too generic to be helpful.
ex.zh: 這封電子郵件寫得太籠統，沒什麼幫助。

ex.en: Please avoid generic answers in the interview.
ex.zh: 面試時請避免太制式的回答。

ex.en: Generic drugs are much cheaper than brand-name ones.
ex.zh: 學名藥比原廠藥便宜很多。

ex.en: I usually buy the generic brand at the supermarket.
ex.zh: 我在超市通常買無品牌的商品。

ex.en: That's a sweeping generalization.
ex.zh: 那是以偏概全的說法。

ex.en: It's hard to make generalizations about customer behavior.
ex.zh: 顧客的行為很難一概而論。

ex.en: The hospital has a backup generator.
ex.zh: 醫院有備用發電機。

ex.en: We used a generator during the blackout.
ex.zh: 停電期間我們用了發電機。

ex.en: This website has a free password generator.
ex.zh: 這個網站有免費的密碼產生器。

ex.en: Tourism is a major generator of jobs.
ex.zh: 觀光業是創造就業的重要來源。

ex.en: We're planning a weekend getaway to Hualien.
ex.zh: 我們正計劃去花蓮度個週末小假。

ex.en: The resort is a perfect getaway from city life.
ex.zh: 這個度假村是逃離城市生活的好去處。

ex.en: The thieves made their getaway in a stolen car.
ex.zh: 竊賊開著偷來的車逃逸。

ex.en: The robbers made a quick getaway.
ex.zh: 搶匪迅速逃走了。

ex.en: The company has a wide geographic reach.
ex.zh: 這家公司的業務遍及廣大地區。

ex.en: The map shows the geographic location of each store.
ex.zh: 這張地圖標出每家門市的地理位置。

ex.en: The company has a wide geographical reach.
ex.zh: 這家公司的業務遍及廣大地區。

ex.en: Geographical location affects shipping costs.
ex.zh: 地理位置會影響運費。

ex.en: The museum teaches visitors about the history of genocide.
ex.zh: 這座博物館讓參觀者了解種族滅絕的歷史。

ex.en: International law treats genocide as a serious crime.
ex.zh: 國際法把種族滅絕視為嚴重罪行。

ex.en: I'm genuinely sorry for the trouble.
ex.zh: 造成你的麻煩，我真的很抱歉。

ex.en: She seemed genuinely interested in our product.
ex.zh: 她似乎真的對我們的產品有興趣。

ex.en: I like geography and history.
ex.zh: 我喜歡地理和歷史。

ex.en: In geography class, the teacher showed a globe to the students.
ex.zh: 地理課上，老師拿地球儀給同學們看。

ex.en: Taiwan's geography includes high mountains and long coastlines.
ex.zh: 台灣的地形包含高山與漫長的海岸線。

ex.en: I don't know the geography of this city very well.
ex.zh: 我不太熟悉這座城市的地理環境。

ex.en: Don't generalize individual behavior to an entire group.
ex.zh: 不要把個人的行為套用到整個群體上。

ex.en: You can't generalize from just one example.
ex.zh: 不能只憑一個例子就下定論。

ex.en: It's unfair to generalize about people from one country.
ex.zh: 以國籍對人一概而論是不公平的。

ex.en: I got an email from my manager.
ex.zh: 我收到主管寄來的電子郵件。

ex.en: Where did you get that bag?
ex.zh: 你那個包包在哪裡買的？

ex.en: It's getting dark.
ex.zh: 天色漸漸暗了。

ex.en: Don't get angry.
ex.zh: 別生氣。

ex.en: What time did you get home?
ex.zh: 你幾點到家的？

ex.en: How do I get to the train station?
ex.zh: 火車站怎麼去？

ex.en: You have to get this work finished by noon.
ex.zh: 你必須在中午以前把這項工作完成。

ex.en: I need to get my hair cut.
ex.zh: 我需要去剪頭髮。

ex.en: Sorry, I don't get it.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我不懂。

ex.en: Did you get the joke?
ex.zh: 你聽懂那個笑話了嗎？

ex.en: The general opinion is that the plan is good.
ex.zh: 大家普遍認為這個計畫不錯。

ex.en: This book is for general readers.
ex.zh: 這本書是寫給一般讀者看的。

ex.en: The general meeting began at 9 am on the dot.
ex.zh: 大會在早上九點整開始。

ex.en: The general strike paralyzed the whole country.
ex.zh: 全面罷工癱瘓了整個國家。

ex.en: She is the general manager of the hotel.
ex.zh: 她是這家飯店的總經理。

ex.en: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
ex.zh: 一般來說，消費者重量不重質。

ex.en: In general, children are fond of candy.
ex.zh: 一般來說，小孩都喜歡吃糖果。

ex.en: In general, men run faster than women.
ex.zh: 一般來說，男性跑得比女性快。

ex.en: Students generally like a teacher who understands their problems.
ex.zh: 學生通常喜歡能理解他們問題的老師。

ex.en: Children generally have a higher body temperature than adults.
ex.zh: 小孩的體溫通常比大人高。

ex.en: Generally speaking, men can run faster than women can.
ex.zh: 一般來說，男性跑得比女性快。

ex.en: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
ex.zh: 整體來說，日本的氣候溫和。

ex.en: It is said that the younger generation today is apathetic.
ex.zh: 有人說現在的年輕一代很冷漠。

ex.en: We should pass on our culture to the next generation.
ex.zh: 我們應該把文化傳承給下一代。

ex.en: My parents' generation went through the war.
ex.zh: 我父母那一代經歷過戰爭。

ex.en: The new generation of smartphones is much faster.
ex.zh: 新一代的智慧型手機快多了。

ex.en: This is the third generation of the product.
ex.zh: 這是這款產品的第三代。

ex.en: The machine generated large amounts of electricity.
ex.zh: 那台機器發出了大量電力。

ex.en: An electric current can generate magnetism.
ex.zh: 電流可以產生磁性。

ex.en: Tourism generated many new jobs.
ex.zh: 觀光業創造了許多新的工作機會。

ex.en: Some diseases are caused by a defective gene.
ex.zh: 有些疾病是由基因缺陷引起的。

ex.en: Eye color is controlled by genes.
ex.zh: 眼睛的顏色由基因決定。

ex.en: She has good genes; her whole family lives long.
ex.zh: 她基因很好，全家人都很長壽。

ex.en: A true gentleman would not betray his friends.
ex.zh: 真正的紳士不會出賣朋友。

ex.en: The man I saw yesterday was a complete gentleman.
ex.zh: 我昨天見到的那位男士是個十足的紳士。

gentleman.zh: 先生（對男士的尊稱，ladies and gentlemen：各位女士先生）

ex.en: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen.
ex.zh: 各位女士、先生，晚安。

ex.en: Ladies and gentlemen, due to an accident at the airport, our arrival will be delayed.
ex.zh: 各位女士、先生，由於機場發生意外，我們將延後抵達。

ex.en: The suspect's gender is currently unknown.
ex.zh: 嫌犯的性別目前不明。

ex.en: What is your gender?
ex.zh: 你的性別是什麼？

ex.en: Salaries should not depend on gender.
ex.zh: 薪資不應該因性別而有差異。

ex.en: Should we use genetic engineering on people?
ex.zh: 我們應該對人類進行基因改造嗎？

ex.en: Through genetic modification, we can improve crops.
ex.zh: 透過基因改造，我們可以改良農作物。

ex.en: The disease is caused by a genetic problem.
ex.zh: 這種疾病是由基因問題引起的。

ex.en: She gave me a hand gesture I didn't understand.
ex.zh: 她對我比了一個我看不懂的手勢。

ex.en: Gestures are very important in human communication.
ex.zh: 手勢在人類溝通中非常重要。

ex.en: They communicate with each other by gesture.
ex.zh: 他們用手勢溝通。

ex.en: Sending flowers was a kind gesture.
ex.zh: 送花是很貼心的舉動。

ex.en: As a gesture of thanks, we gave him a gift.
ex.zh: 為了表達謝意，我們送他一份禮物。

ex.en: Father gestured to me to leave the room.
ex.zh: 父親示意我離開房間。

ex.en: She gestured for me to sit down.
ex.zh: 她示意我坐下。

ex.en: Do you have rain gear with you?
ex.zh: 你有帶雨具嗎？

ex.en: Don't forget to bring your camping gear.
ex.zh: 別忘了帶你的露營裝備。

ex.en: The store sells sports gear at low prices.
ex.zh: 這家店以低價販售運動用品。

ex.en: Dust in the gears gummed up the machine.
ex.zh: 齒輪裡的灰塵讓機器卡住了。

ex.en: Shift into first gear before you start driving.
ex.zh: 開車前先打到一檔。

gear.zh: 使適合、使配合（be geared to/toward）

ex.en: The course is geared toward beginners.
ex.zh: 這門課是為初學者設計的。

ex.en: Our products are geared to young consumers.
ex.zh: 我們的產品針對年輕消費者。

ex.en: This might not be a genuine diamond.
ex.zh: 這可能不是真鑽石。

ex.en: These pearls are genuine, not artificial.
ex.zh: 這些珍珠是真的，不是人造的。

ex.en: She showed genuine interest in our proposal.
ex.zh: 她對我們的提案表現出真誠的興趣。

ex.en: He made a genuine effort to help us.
ex.zh: 他是真心誠意想幫我們。

ex.en: My grandfather is a kind and gentle man.
ex.zh: 我爺爺是個親切溫和的人。

ex.en: Be gentle with the baby.
ex.zh: 對寶寶要溫柔一點。

ex.en: She gave the door a gentle push.
ex.zh: 她輕輕推了一下門。

ex.en: A gentle breeze is blowing.
ex.zh: 微風輕輕吹著。

ex.en: A gentle wind made ripples on the surface of the pond.
ex.zh: 微風在池面吹起陣陣漣漪。

ex.en: The nurse gently put a bandage around my head.
ex.zh: 護士輕柔地幫我的頭纏上繃帶。

ex.en: He put his hand gently on her shoulder.
ex.zh: 他把手輕輕放在她肩上。

ex.en: The willow branches swayed gently in the breeze.
ex.zh: 柳枝在微風中輕輕搖曳。

ex.en: The hill rises gently behind the village.
ex.zh: 村莊後方的山丘緩緩升起。

ex.en: Prices rose gently over the year.
ex.zh: 物價這一年溫和上漲。

ex.en: Some diseases are genetically inherited.
ex.zh: 有些疾病是遺傳的。

ex.en: These crops have been genetically modified.
ex.zh: 這些作物經過基因改造。

ex.en: She is studying genetics at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學念遺傳學。

ex.en: Your height is largely determined by genetics.
ex.zh: 身高主要是由遺傳決定的。

ex.en: I found it difficult to get along with him.
ex.zh: 我覺得很難和他相處。

ex.en: Tom and Mary never got along.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗一直合不來。

ex.en: My father gets along with his friends.
ex.zh: 我爸爸和朋友的關係很好。

ex.en: How are you getting along with your English study?
ex.zh: 你的英文學得怎麼樣？

ex.en: How are you getting along at your new job?
ex.zh: 你新工作做得怎麼樣？

ex.en: What genres of music are you into?
ex.zh: 你喜歡哪種類型的音樂？

ex.en: Horror is my favorite movie genre.
ex.zh: 恐怖片是我最喜歡的電影類型。

ex.en: I had great admiration for his generosity.
ex.zh: 我很欽佩他的慷慨大方。

ex.en: Thanks for your generosity.
ex.zh: 謝謝你的慷慨。

ex.en: Thanks to the generosity of local people, the school built a new library.
ex.zh: 多虧當地居民慷慨解囊，學校蓋了一座新圖書館。

gerrymander.zh: 不公正地劃分選區（以圖利某政黨）

ex.en: Critics say the party gerrymandered the districts to win more seats.
ex.zh: 批評者說該黨不公正地重劃選區，以贏得更多席次。

ex.en: Gerrymandering makes elections less fair.
ex.zh: 不公正地劃分選區會讓選舉變得不公平。

ex.en: I have to get off at the next stop.
ex.zh: 我要在下一站下車。

ex.en: While getting off the bus, she heard her name called.
ex.zh: 她一下車，就聽到有人叫她的名字。

ex.en: Don't get off the train till it stops.
ex.zh: 列車停下前別下車。

ex.en: We saw the child get on the bus.
ex.zh: 我們看見孩子上了車。

ex.en: We happened to get on the same bus.
ex.zh: 我們剛好搭上同一班公車。

ex.en: He is a man hard to get on with.
ex.zh: 他是個很難相處的男人。

ex.en: I get on well with my roommate.
ex.zh: 我和室友相處得很好。
